c2_clearance_evaluator_audit.c4_authority_transfer: C2 rebuilds its scene from pose rows; direct use of the C4 authoritative manifest is not established there. C5A instead loads the frozen C4 181-object manifest directly.
c2_clearance_evaluator_audit.nearest_points: not retained in the C2 Distance record or result rows
c2_clearance_evaluator_audit.padding_semantics: uses getCollisionEnv() from a separately constructed scene; no explicit getCollisionEnvUnpadded() call, so an unpadded guarantee is not established by the C2 implementation

c2_clearance_evaluator_audit.signed_semantics: enable_signed_distance=true; MoveIt DistanceResultsData defines <=0 as collision

claim_boundaries.COVERAGE: 25 deterministic engineering registration cases only; no broad Monte Carlo or C5B boundary search

acm.source: C4 identity replay and frozen SRDF-derived PlanningScene

measurement_contract.clearance_backend: PlanningScene.getCollisionEnvUnpadded() MoveIt2 CollisionEnvFCL distanceRobot/distanceSelf; request GLOBAL, padding=0.0, scale=1.0

clearance_query_domains.robot_world: distanceRobot only; nearest robot link and world object are reported
clearance_query_domains.self: distanceSelf separately; robot link pair only

measurement_contract.collision_backend: active MoveIt2 PlanningScene FCL, pad_environment_collisions=true, pad_self_collisions=false
measurement_contract.process_metric_physical_thresholds: NOT_APPLIED_TO_REGISTRATION_PERTURBATIONS; C1 configured criteria remain C1 provenance only
measurement_contract.process_normal_metric: per-waypoint angle in radians and degrees between frozen FK rotation column +Z and C1 projected open-arch surface normal after registration; exact C1 _project_to_polyline_with_normals function
measurement_contract.process_position_metric: per-waypoint Euclidean distance from frozen FK TCP position to C1 target TCP position after the same left-composed registration transform
measurement_contract.process_standoff_metric: signed projected stand-off error using C1 STAND_OFF=0.260 m and tcp_points_to_wall=true convention
measurement_contract.rotation_frame_and_origin: base_link; right-handed axis-angle about base_link origin

moveitpy_api_introspection.measurement_route: native MoveIt2 C++ CollisionEnvFCL; no Python CollisionResult.distance relabeling
moveitpy_api_introspection.runtime: ROS 2 Jazzy MoveItPy imported from moveit.planning and moveit.core
